title: Be able to
subtitle: 能夠、有能力、有條件、成功做到——究竟是哪一種 be able to？
description: 能夠、有能力、有條件、成功做到——究竟是哪一種 be able to？

words.note: 和 be able to 最直接、最常見的替代。表示能力、可能性或在某些語境中的許可。一般現在時尤其自然。

exercises.original: With the new software, users are able to edit videos on their phones.
exercises.zh: 有了新軟件後，使用者可以在手機上編輯影片。
exercises.upgrade: can · 能；可以

options.explanation: — can = 能、可以，最自然地表達一般能力。
— might = 可能，表示不確定性。

exercises.original: She is able to speak three languages fluently.
exercises.zh: 她能流利地說三種語言。
exercises.upgrade: can · 能；可以

options.explanation: — can 直接表達語言能力。
— may 常表示可能或許可，不是能力的最佳表達。
— would 表示假設／過去習慣等。

exercises.original: The device is able to detect very small changes in temperature.
exercises.zh: 這部裝置能偵測非常細微的溫度變化。
exercises.upgrade: can · 能；可以

options.explanation: — can 表示裝置具備這項功能／能力。
— must 表示義務，不適用於能力。
— might 表示可能，不代表穩定能力。

words.note: 較正式，表示某人或某物具備完成某事的能力、性能或潛力。通常接名詞或 -ing。

exercises.original: The machine is able to operate in extremely cold conditions.
exercises.zh: 這部機器能在極寒環境下運作。
exercises.upgrade: is capable of · 有能力；能夠

options.explanation: — is capable of operating 正式地表示機器具備這項性能。
— is required to = 被要求做。
— is likely to = 很可能會。
— is prevented from = 被阻止做。
— is expected to = 預期會／被期望做。
— is supposed to = 應該／按理要。

exercises.original: Children are able to learn several languages at the same time.
exercises.zh: 兒童能同時學習幾種語言。
exercises.upgrade: are capable of · 有能力；能夠

options.explanation: — are capable of learning 強調兒童具備這種能力。
— are meant to = 預定／應當。

exercises.original: This material is able to withstand very high temperatures.
exercises.zh: 這種材料能承受非常高的溫度。
exercises.upgrade: is capable of · 有能力；能夠

options.explanation: — is capable of withstanding 表示材料的性能。
— is responsible for = 負責／導致。

words.note: 非常接近 be able to，比 can 更明確把焦點放在「能力本身」。常見於正式說明、教育、招聘和能力描述。

exercises.original: Successful managers are able to make decisions under pressure.
exercises.zh: 成功的管理人員具有在壓力下作決定的能力。
exercises.upgrade: have the ability to · 具有……的能力

options.explanation: — have the ability to 直接強調決策能力。
— have no choice but to = 別無選擇只好。

exercises.original: The software is able to recognise speech in noisy environments.
exercises.zh: 這個軟件具備在嘈雜環境中辨識語音的能力。
exercises.upgrade: has the ability to · 具有……的能力

options.explanation: — has the ability to 清楚描述軟件功能能力。
— has a duty to = 有責任。
— has failed to = 未能做到。

exercises.original: She is able to remain calm during emergencies.
exercises.zh: 她具有在緊急情況下保持冷靜的能力。
exercises.upgrade: has the ability to · 具有……的能力

options.explanation: — has the ability to 強調她本身具備這項能力。

words.note: 較正式，可表示人、組織或系統具備完成某事的能力或承載能力。比 have the ability to 更常見於制度、技術、組織和資源語境。

exercises.original: The hospital is able to treat up to 500 patients a day.
exercises.zh: 醫院有能力每天治療多達五百名病人。
exercises.upgrade: has the capacity to · 具有……的能力／容量

options.explanation: — has the capacity to 很適合機構處理量／承載能力語境。
— is expected to = 預期／被期望。
— is meant to = 旨在／應當。

exercises.original: The system is able to process much larger datasets after the upgrade.
exercises.zh: 升級後，系統有能力處理大得多的數據集。
exercises.upgrade: has the capacity to · 具有……的能力／容量

options.explanation: — has the capacity to 強調系統的處理能力提升。
— has no choice but to = 別無選擇。
— is supposed to = 應當／預期。

exercises.original: The organisation is able to respond quickly to emergencies.
exercises.zh: 這個機構具備迅速應對緊急情況的能力。
exercises.upgrade: has the capacity to · 具有……的能力／容量

options.explanation: — has the capacity to 表示組織具備所需資源和能力。
— is trying to = 正在嘗試。

words.meaning: 有條件；有能力；處於可以……的位置
words.note: 表示某人或機構因為時間、權限、資源、資訊或情況合適，所以能夠做某事。比純粹 be able to 更強調外部條件。

exercises.original: After receiving the funding, the team was able to begin the next phase.
exercises.zh: 獲得資金後，團隊已有條件展開下一階段。
exercises.upgrade: was in a position to · 有條件；有能力；處於可以……的位置

options.explanation: — was in a position to 強調資金到位後具備條件。
— was unlikely to = 不太可能。
— was supposed to = 應當／原定。

exercises.original: Once the report is complete, the board will be able to make a final decision.
exercises.zh: 報告完成後，董事會便有條件作出最終決定。
exercises.upgrade: will be in a position to · 有條件；有能力；處於可以……的位置
exercises.answer: will be in a position to

options.text: will be in a position to
options.explanation: — will be in a position to 表示具備足夠資訊後才能作決定。
— will be forced to = 將被迫。
— will be prevented from = 將被阻止。
— will be required to = 將被要求。
— will be unlikely to = 將不太可能。
— will be reluctant to = 將不情願。

exercises.original: With more staff, the clinic will be able to extend its opening hours.
exercises.zh: 增加人手後，診所便有條件延長開放時間。
exercises.upgrade: will be in a position to · 有條件；有能力；處於可以……的位置
exercises.answer: will be in a position to

options.text: will be in a position to
options.explanation: — will be in a position to 強調因人手增加而條件成熟。
— will be prevented from = 將被阻止。
— will be advised to = 將被建議。

words.note: 表示某件事有難度，但最終成功做到。和 be able to 在特定完成事件中很接近，但 manage to 多了『克服困難而成功』的意味。

exercises.original: Despite the heavy traffic, we were able to arrive on time.
exercises.zh: 儘管交通擠塞，我們仍成功準時到達。
exercises.upgrade: managed to · 設法做到；成功能夠

options.explanation: — managed to 強調克服交通困難後成功做到。
— failed to = 未能，意思相反。

exercises.original: She was able to open the door after several attempts.
exercises.zh: 試了幾次後，她終於成功把門打開。
exercises.upgrade: managed to · 設法做到；成功能夠

options.explanation: — managed to 和 after several attempts 呼應，表示最後成功。
— was supposed to = 應當／原定。

exercises.original: The rescue team was able to reach the village before dark.
exercises.zh: 救援隊成功在天黑前抵達村莊。
exercises.upgrade: managed to · 設法做到；成功能夠

options.explanation: — managed to 適合帶有時間壓力或困難的成功完成。

words.note: 較正式，表示具備足夠技能、知識或資格去完成某項工作。比 be able to 更強調勝任程度。

exercises.original: Only qualified engineers are able to inspect the system safely.
exercises.zh: 只有合資格工程師才有能力安全檢查系統。
exercises.upgrade: are competent to · 有能力勝任；具備資格

options.explanation: — are competent to 強調合資格和勝任能力。
— are allowed to = 被允許，重點是許可。

exercises.original: She is able to handle complex legal cases independently.
exercises.zh: 她有能力獨立處理複雜法律案件。
exercises.upgrade: is competent to · 有能力勝任；具備資格

options.explanation: — is competent to 表示她具備足夠專業能力勝任。
— is trying to = 正在嘗試。

exercises.original: The technician is able to perform the repair without supervision.
exercises.zh: 技術員有能力在無監督下完成維修。
exercises.upgrade: is competent to · 有能力勝任；具備資格

options.explanation: — is competent to 強調具備獨立完成工作的技能。
— is authorised to = 獲授權，重點是權限。

words.meaning: 具備條件／裝備去；有能力應付
words.note: 表示因為擁有所需技能、知識、設備或資源，所以能夠處理某事。比 be able to 更強調『準備／資源齊全』。

exercises.original: After the training, staff are able to deal with difficult customers more effectively.
exercises.zh: 接受培訓後，員工更有能力有效處理難應付的顧客。
exercises.upgrade: are equipped to · 具備條件／裝備去；有能力應付

options.explanation: — are equipped to 強調培訓令員工具備所需技能。
— are supposed to = 應當／預期。

exercises.original: The new laboratory is able to conduct advanced genetic testing.
exercises.zh: 新實驗室具備進行先進基因測試的設備和條件。
exercises.upgrade: is equipped to · 具備條件／裝備去；有能力應付

options.explanation: — is equipped to 特別適合設備與資源充足的實驗室語境。
— is expected to = 預期／被期望。
— is trying to = 正在嘗試。

exercises.original: With the new vehicles, the rescue unit is able to reach remote areas.
exercises.zh: 有了新車輛後，救援隊具備前往偏遠地區的條件。
exercises.upgrade: is equipped to · 具備條件／裝備去；有能力應付

options.explanation: — is equipped to 明確表示因新設備而具備能力。

words.note: 在某些語境可近似 be able to，但重點是具備正式資格、訓練或認證，因此能合法或適當地做某事。

exercises.original: Only licensed doctors are able to prescribe this medication.
exercises.zh: 只有持牌醫生才有資格處方這種藥物。
exercises.upgrade: are qualified to · 有資格；具備資格去

options.explanation: — are qualified to 強調持牌資格。
— are trying to = 正在嘗試。

exercises.original: She is able to teach the course because she holds the required certification.
exercises.zh: 她因持有所需認證，所以有資格教授這個課程。
exercises.upgrade: is qualified to · 有資格；具備資格去

options.explanation: — is qualified to 和 required certification 直接呼應。

exercises.original: The operator is able to use the equipment independently after completing the certification course.
exercises.zh: 操作員完成認證課程後，有資格獨立使用設備。
exercises.upgrade: is qualified to · 有資格；具備資格去

options.explanation: — is qualified to 表示完成認證後具備正式資格。
— is permitted to = 獲准，未必代表有資格能力。

words.note: 較口語，常見於 be up to the task / be up to doing something，表示有足夠能力、體力或精神去應付某事。

exercises.original: Do you think she is able to handle such a demanding role?
exercises.zh: 你認為她有能力應付這麼吃力的職位嗎？
exercises.upgrade: is up to · 有能力應付；勝任

options.explanation: — is up to 可口語地表示能否應付某項要求高的工作。
— is forced into = 被迫進入。

exercises.original: I'm not sure I am able to complete the hike today.
exercises.zh: 我不確定自己今天是否有體力／能力完成遠足。
exercises.upgrade: am up to · 有能力應付；勝任

options.explanation: — am up to completing 強調目前體力／狀態是否足以應付。

exercises.original: The small team proved that it was able to meet the challenge.
exercises.zh: 小團隊證明自己有能力應付這項挑戰。
exercises.upgrade: was up to · 有能力應付；勝任

options.explanation: — was up to the challenge 是常見固定表達，表示有能力應付挑戰。
— was interested in = 對……有興趣。

falseSynonyms.zh: 可能／獲准不等於有能力 may 常表示可能性或許可；只有在少數語境與 can 接近，但不是 be able to 的一般能力同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: She may come tomorrow. / She is able to swim 2 km.

falseSynonyms.zh: 獲准不等於能夠 be allowed to 是許可；某人可能獲准做某事但沒有能力做到，也可能有能力但不獲准。
falseSynonyms.point: He is allowed to drive the vehicle, but he may not be able to handle it safely.

falseSynonyms.zh: 知道方法不等於一定能做到 know how to 強調知識或技巧步驟；be able to 包括實際能力與條件。
falseSynonyms.point: She knows how to repair it, but she isn't physically able to lift it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 願意不等於有能力 willing 表示意願，和 ability 不同。
falseSynonyms.point: He is willing to help, but he isn't able to stay late.

falseSynonyms.zh: 被允許不等於有能力 permitted 和 allowed 一樣是權限概念。
falseSynonyms.point: Only staff are permitted to enter.

falseSynonyms.zh: 很可能不等於能夠 likely 表示事件發生機率高，不表示能力。
成功做到不等於一般能力 manage to 只在有難度而最終成功的單次／具體事件中接近；不能所有 be able to 都替換。
falseSynonyms.point: He managed to escape after several attempts.

falseSynonyms.zh: 勝任能力比一般 able 更窄 competent 強調技能／資格達標，不是所有日常能力語境都自然。
falseSynonyms.point: She is competent to carry out the assessment.
